newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes little changed.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes little changed.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Monday closed little changed in more active trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 606.44 from 606.26 on Friday.
Traded volume rose to 2.174 million dinars from 789,455 dinars. The bond market was active with transactions amounting to 907,000 dinars.
BIAT bank was up 1.78s dinar to 61.44 dinars. Detergents firm SPCD up 1.74 dinars to 54.9 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix up 1.42 dinars to 48.87 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT was down 1.22 dinars to 39.4 dinars.
